Ravi P: Flagging a bug from last night's role-mapping change. In one tenant a viewer user sees the 'Edit' action in the project page. Clicking it returns 403 but the affordance is present.
Noor A: thanks for the report. is this on the migration cohort we rolled 00:30?
Ravi P: yes. tenant 'greenwave' affected. quick repro: login as viewer -> edit button visible -> click -> server 403. frontend console shows perms: {project_edit: true} pulled from local cache.
Tess W: frontend computes perms from role_alias -> permission set mapping stored in localStorage with 6h TTL. during the remap job we swapped alias->role ids but didn't invalidate caches.
Leo M: server side still authoritative. no successful PATCH calls were accepted by api. so no direct data modification risk. main issue: UI leakage and missing audit context when clicks happen.
Noor A: audit-wise we only log click events with actor, route, and status. we don't persist previous_role or mapping_rev in the audit blob. that makes migration triage slow.
Ravi P: right. also noticed the encrypted audit envelope uses KMS version v1 and doesn't include schema_version header so new fields will break older readers.
Tess W: action plan proposal: 1) quick UX hardening: change console to hide critical action affordances unless server-side /authz/route check returns allowed. deploy under ff:server-checked-perms. 2) migration job: emit websocket invalidation messages for active sessions for remapped tenants. 3) audit schema: append prev_role and mapping_rev to audit payload; bump envelope to v2 and ensure backward-compatible readers ignore unknown fields. 4) alerting: surface a signal when client-visible affordance != server allow for critical routes.
Leo M: for 1) I can put up a small change to call /authz/effective?routes=project_edit at page render and gate render. low perf cost if cached per page load.
Noor A: for KMS + audit: we must use envelope.v2 with an explicit schema_version string so the decrypt pipeline can accept v1 and v2. also rotate the KMS key policy to include the migration runner service account.
Ravi P: detection query I suggest: `select tenant, count(*) from ui_events where route='project_edit' and server_status=403 group by tenant having count(*) > 3` — hook an alert on that.
Tess W: I'll add a migration step to push an invalidation broadcast and a backfill script to trigger SSE for all active sessions in the window. also add unit test to migration that writes a sample audit record and roundtrips decrypt.
Leo M: performed a quick scan of logs -> ~42 click events in the last 6 hours across 3 tenants, all server 403. no successful edits.
sec-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: role-mapping-run-2026-03-20T00:30Z emitted 0-session-invalidations. see runbook link /incidents/role-mapping-20260320.md
Noor A: owners: Tess -> session invalidation backfill + tests; Leo -> frontend server-checked gating PR and canary; Ravi -> detection alert and postmortem doc; Noor -> audit schema + KMS envelope bump + coordinate key policy.
Ravi P: timeline: gating PR today, canary tonight, audit schema changes planned for tomorrow with a small migration to re-encrypt sample blobs.
Tess W: note for docs: frontend guidance - never rely solely on client-side cached perm projections for sensitive surfaces (billing, keys, edits). Also add a small checklist in the migration playbook to emit invalidation and write audit prev_role.
Leo M: will drop PR link here once ready. thanks all. :thumbsup:
